project.name: Gimle Skald
project.description: The cluster DNS server: a small first-party UDP responder answering standard A queries for <service>.<tenant>.svc.gimle.local (untenanted: <service>.svc.gimle.local) by polling the control plane's Service/endpoint API and caching the result in memory. Gives workloads with no fabric-registry access of their own -- anything that can only do a plain socket lookup, not just fabric-aware Java -- a way to resolve a Service name to a live address.
